message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.beam_mirrors.h: A beam leaves the golden block heading east. Right-click the mirrors to turn them until the beam lights the red crystal.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.chain_reaction: A right click adds a charge to a crystal. A crystal with as much charge as it has neighbours bursts and charges them in turn. Burst the golden core crystal before the clicks run out.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.cmd.apply.ok: Started %s here (#%s). Crouch and right-click its lectern twice to give up.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.cmd.info: Family %s, %s cells at tier 1 for one delver.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.cmd.list.head: Puzzle rooms: %s puzzles, at most %s a floor, switched %s.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.cmd.plan.head: Sector %s (theme %s): %s planned.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.cmd.plan.none: You are not in a sector.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.cmd.player: Only a player can do that.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.cmd.reset: Cleared and given-up puzzles may start again.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.cmd.verify.ok: All %s puzzles pass: solvable by their own hint, palettes and texts complete.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.colour_mix.hin: Each lamp mixes its two pillars: red and blue make purple, red and yellow orange, blue and yellow green. Make every lamp match the colour above it. Right-click a pillar to change its colour.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.common.adminNo: No room for that puzzle here.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.common.bypass: The mechanism grinds to a halt. Nothing is locked, but it pays nothing.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.common.bypassW: The mechanism is winding down: it lets you go in %s seconds.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.common.cooling: The mechanism is cooling down for a moment.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.common.dismiss: Crouch and right-click the lectern again to give up on this puzzle.
You give up the puzzle. The way stays open, and it pays nothing.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.common.fade: The pattern fades from the floor.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.common.flawles: Not one mistake: the mechanism pays double.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.common.jam: The mechanism jams from too much fiddling.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.common.nudge: Stuck? Right-click the lectern for the hint.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.common.pity: A faint glow shows where to try next.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.common.tooMany: Too many mistakes: the mechanism starts over.
Right-click the stars to draw one closed figure through all of them without ever crossing your own thread. Click the last star again to take a thread back, and close the figure on the first star.
That star is already on the thread.
The thread snaps where it would cross itself.
Take shards from the four crystals. Each pedestal wants a compound of two elements (steam is fire and water ...). Offer two shards with a right click; crouch to empty a pedestal.
This pedestal wants %s (%s of 2 shards given).
The shade caught the spirit and it flees back to the start.
Stand on the tile ahead of the pale spirit to light its way. Keep ahead of the creeping shade, and stand on the shade's tile to push it back.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.gravity_maze.h: Tip the room with the arrow pillars. The lit marble slides until a wall stops it. Drop it into the gold hole.
Purple shards that ring like a bell when struck, grown in a hollow of stone.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.item.bone.q: The dead leave me behind, and wolves would sit for me.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.item.coal.q: Born in the dark of the deep, black as night, I give my warmth when you burn me.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.item.copper.q: An orange metal that turns green as it ages.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.item.diamond.q: The hardest gem, found at the deepest layers, bright as ice.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.item.emerald.q: Green and bright, I buy bread from villagers.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.item.gold.q: Kings wear me and fools chase me, and I never rust.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.item.iron.q: I am forged into the blade and the shield, and I rust if left out in the rain.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.item.lapis.q: Deep blue as the night sky, scholars grind me into ink and dye.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.item.quartz.q: White and hard, grown in the red lands of fire, I am the stone of the Nether.
A red dust that wakes sleeping wires.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.key_and_lock.h: Take a key from its pedestal (right-click) and carry it to the lock of the same colour. Opening a lock frees the next key.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.key_and_lock.n: The lock wants a key of its colour.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.key_and_lock.s: This pedestal is sealed until the lock before it opens.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.lights_out.hin: Right-click a tile to flip it and the four tiles beside it. Light every tile.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.melody_notes.h: Strike the bell to hear the tune. Play it back on the note pillars (light is low, dark is high), then touch the stave stone.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.melody_notes.o: Off key. The notes fall silent.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.memory_tiles.h: Step on a tile to see its symbol, then find its twin. Matching tiles stay lit. Too many mistakes and the floor shuffles itself.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.memory_tiles.s: Too many mistakes: the floor shuffles itself.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.mimic_chests.h: Exactly one inscription tells the truth. Right-click a chest to read its inscription, and open it with a crouching right click. Only one chest is real.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.mimic_chests.i: Chest %s says: the treasure is in chest %s.
Chest %s says: the treasure is not in chest %s.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.number_lock.hi: Right-click the plaques scattered about the room: each states a fact about the code. Set the dials (crouch to turn back) and touch the lock stone.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.pendulum_cross: Cross the lanes to the far row. A blade sweeps each lane: red is where it is, amber where it goes next. Step where it is not.
The blade caught you: back to the start row.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.pipe_connect.h: Right-click a pipe tile to turn it. Join the golden inlet to the drain on the far side; wet pipes show where the water goes.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.pit_jump.hint: The column of colours beside the field names the safe colour of each row. Step only on tiles of that colour, from one end of the field to the other; any other tile gives way.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.pit_jump.name: The Coloured Floor
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.plate_sequence: Read the coloured tiles on the wall side, then step on the plates of the same colours in that order. A wrong plate puts the lights out.
A wrong plate: the lights go out.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.riddle.clock.q: What has hands but cannot clap?
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.riddle.cloud.q: I fly without wings, I cry without eyes, and wherever I go, darkness follows. What am I?
The one who makes me does not need me; the one who buys me does not use me; the one who uses me never knows it. What am I?
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.riddle.darknes: The more of me there is, the less you see. What am I?
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.riddle.echo.q: I speak without a mouth and answer when you call. What am I?
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.riddle.fire.q: Feed me and I live; give me water and I die. What am I?
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.riddle.flame.q: I am not alive, but I grow; I have no lungs, but I need air. What am I?
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.riddle.footste: The more of me you take, the more you leave behind. What am I?
What is always in front of you but can never be seen?
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.riddle.map.q: I have cities but no houses, mountains but no trees, and water but no fish. What am I?
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.riddle.piano.q: What has keys but cannot open a lock?
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.riddle.river.q: What runs but never walks, has a mouth but never talks, and has a bed but never sleeps?
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.riddle.silence: What breaks the moment you speak its name?
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.riddle.ton.q: Forward I am heavy, backward I am not. What am I?
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.riddle.towel.q: What gets wetter the more it dries?
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.riddle.umbrell: What goes up when the rain comes down?
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.riddle_door.hi: Answer the sphinx's riddles by clicking an answer in chat. A wrong answer costs you and brings a different riddle. Right-click the sphinx to hear the riddle again.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.riddle_offerin: Each altar speaks a riddle whose answer is a thing. Take that thing from the matching bowl (right-click it) and offer it to the altar with a right click.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.rotating_pilla: Right-click the stones to turn them until every one faces the arrow on the compass stone. Meshing gears drag a neighbour round too.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.rune_copy.hint: Copy the master runes onto your stones: right-click a stone to change its rune (crouch to go back), then touch the seal stone. Deeper down the master fades; the oracle stone shows it again.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.rune_copy.name: The Copyist's Stones
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.sentry_stealth: Cross the lanes to the far row. A lane is watched while its statue and tiles glow red: wait until it looks away. Amber is a warning.
A statue saw you: back to the start row.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.shadow_cast.hi: Right-click the pillars to turn them until the shadow row on the wall matches the wanted row.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.simon_levers.h: Watch and listen to the levers, then press them in the same order. Each round adds one more.
Right-click a tile in the hole's row or column to slide the line toward the hole. Put the numbers in order, like the picture beside the grid.
Only a tile in the hole's row or column can slide.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.sundial.hint: A shadow creeps round the ring of hours. Right-click the gnomon in the moment the shadow lies on the gold stone.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.sundial.name: The Sundial Without a Sun
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.theme.abyss: Something far below turns its attention to you: %s.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.theme.astral: The stars left a lesson in the floor: %s.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.theme.blood: The stone is warm and wet, and it remembers a game: %s.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.theme.celestia: The court sets a trial of wit before judgement: %s.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.theme.crystal_: The crystals hum a test through the rock: %s.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.theme.cursed_a: A librarian's ghost slides a card across the table: %s.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.theme.default: An old mechanism wakes as you enter: %s.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.theme.drowned_: Water drips in time with an old lock: %s.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.theme.dwarven_: The smiths built a mechanism here and never took it down: %s.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.theme.feywild_: The fey love a game, and they have made one: %s.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.theme.flame: Heat shimmers over a device of fire and stone: %s.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.theme.frost: Frost has crept into the gears but they still turn: %s.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.theme.fungal_u: Pale spores drift over a device someone left to rot: %s.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.theme.gravity: The floor leans a little, as if the puzzle itself were heavy: %s.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.theme.haunted_: A parlour game from a house that never ended: %s.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.theme.holy_chu: A catechism carved in stone invites you to answer: %s.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.theme.infernal: The foundry's overseers set a test for new hands: %s.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.theme.mountain: The monks leave a koan in the stone: %s.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.theme.necropol: The dead keep score, and a game is laid out for the living: %s.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.theme.radiant: The light itself is the lock, and you are the key: %s.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.theme.shadow: The dark offers a trade, and a game: %s.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.theme.sky_cita: The winds sing a measure above the clouds: %s.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.theme.spatial: Space folds round a small puzzle: %s.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.theme.spider_w: Webs hold a mechanism as a spider holds a fly: %s.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.theme.sunken_t: The tide worked this lock before the temple sank: %s.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.theme.vampire_: An old lord sets a guest a courtesy: %s.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.theme.verdant: Roots and vines have grown a puzzle round the stone: %s.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.torch_order.gu: A flame woke out of turn: every brazier goes out.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.torch_order.hi: Right-click the lectern: it recites which flame must wake before which. Light the braziers in an order that keeps every rule, or they all go out.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.torch_order.re: The lectern recites %s rules of the flames:
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.torch_order.ru: The %s flame must wake before the %s one.
message.nusmp.mega.puzzle.water_level.hi: Click a tank to pick it, then the spring to fill it, the drain to empty it, or another tank to pour into it. Bring exactly as much water as the glass column shows into one tank.
The height of a stone is its weight. Right-click a stone to put it on the blue pan, on the red pan, or off the scale. Use every stone and make the pans balance.
